title: Automatic cleanup
description: Frees disk on this node on a schedule: unused containers and images, build cache over budget, orphaned volumes (held in quarantine first) and old failed deploy attempts. Rollback targets and volumes used by running apps are never removed.
loadError: Could not load the cleanup status.
notConfigured: Cleanup is not available on this control plane.

status.title: Disk and last pass
status.freeUnknown: Free space is not reported for this node.

pressure.title: Disk space is below the budget
pressure.body: Clean up now removes unused Docker data and old attempts. Anything still in use stays.

stageHelp.containers: Stopped containers no app or database still wants. Runs when disk is short.
stageHelp.images: Untagged images only. Tagged images, which include rollback targets, are never removed.
stageHelp.build_cache: Idle build cache past the age limit, and more when the cache is over budget.
stageHelp.volumes: Volumes no app uses are held in quarantine, then deleted only if you allow it. Database data is never removed.
stageHelp.deploy_attempts: Failed, superseded and canceled attempts past retention. Succeeded attempts and rollback pins stay.
stageHelp.api_tokens: Revoked or expired API tokens past their retention window. Active tokens are never removed. Set the windows under Settings, API tokens.

quarantine.title: Quarantined volumes
quarantine.description: Volumes nothing uses. They are only deleted after the hold ends and automatic deletion is on.

policy.title: Policy
policy.dryRunHelp: Scheduled passes report what they would do and remove nothing. Turn off to start removing.
policy.budgetHelp: Containers and images are cleaned only when free space falls below this.
policy.cacheBudgetHelp: Over this size, idle cache is trimmed more deeply. 0 turns the budget off.
policy.deleteVolumesHelp: Off keeps orphaned volumes listed forever. Database volumes are never deleted.
policy.rootOnly: Only a root account can change the policy.
policy.invalid: Every number must be a whole number of at least 1.
